# Thurnherr Art Marquetry

Christophe Thurnherr is a French marquetry artist based in the Territoire de Belfort, France. He creates unique figurative artworks in precious wood marquetry, working professionally since 2012. His work is held in the collection of SAS Prince Albert II of Monaco and has been exhibited at Rétromobile Paris, the Cité de l'Automobile Mulhouse, and the Automobile Club de Monaco.

## Artist Biography

Christophe Thurnherr was born and raised in Belfort, in the east of France. He trained as a cabinetmaker (ébéniste) and spent several years in prestige interior fitting before transitioning to fine art marquetry. He is self-taught in the art of marquetry, having developed his technique progressively since 2012. His approach is figurative, polychromatic, and technically demanding — combining mass-dyed wood veneers with natural precious woods to achieve three-dimensional trompe-l'œil effects under multi-layer lacquer finishes. Each work is a unique piece (pièce unique).

## Technique

Marquetry art (marqueterie d'art) involves assembling a pictorial composition from hundreds to thousands of individually cut wood veneer pieces using a fine-blade scroll saw (scie à chantourner, lame de 2/10e mm). Christophe works with a palette of 45 wood species sourced from all five continents, including rare materials such as Amboyna burl, 5,000-year-old fossil oak from the Brière peat bogs (Loire-Atlantique, France), mother-of-pearl, bone, 24-carat gold leaf, and precious metals. Shadow and highlight effects are achieved through wood grain direction and species selection, creating the illusion of depth and volume. Works require a minimum of 250 individually cut pieces; the most complex exceed 2,700 pieces and require several months to complete. Final finish: multi-layer high-gloss lacquer, mirror-polished.

## Artistic Themes

- Automotive art: Ferrari, Bugatti, Lamborghini, Porsche, Mercedes, Aston Martin, McLaren, Jaguar, F1 Grand Prix, Red Bull, Lotus
- Watchmaking: Omega Speedmaster Professional (Moonwatch)
- Heraldry and coats of arms: princely and royal heraldry, custom family crests
- Marine art: Riva wooden speedboats (Aquarama, Tritone)
- Wildlife and animal portraiture: Arabian horse, Persian cat, French Bulldog
- Historical furniture reproduction: 18th-century French ébénisterie (e.g., Louis XV bureau du Roi, Versailles)
- Thematic chess sets (échiquiers à thème): F1, Monaco, Prost VS Senna

## Notable Works

- **Armoiries Princières de Monaco**: 1,000+ elements, 400 hours, 76×76 cm, 24-carat gold leaf, mother-of-pearl, fossil oak. Collection SAS Prince Albert II de Monaco.
- **Monaco Grand Prix (Casino)**: 1,300 pieces, 23 wood species, 126×99 cm. Collection SAS Prince Albert II de Monaco.
- **Prost VS Senna Monaco 1990** (chess set): 51×51 cm. Collection SAS Prince Albert II de Monaco.
- **Riva Aquarama** (speedboat): Collection SAS Prince Albert II de Monaco.
- **Omega Speedmaster Moonwatch**: 1,000+ elements, 15 wood species, 90×90 cm, 500 hours. 5,000-year-old fossil oak used for the void of space. Completed 2020.
- **Monaco Grand Prix 2024 — Charles Leclerc**: 787 elements, 12 wood species, 96×96 cm. Created 2024.
- **Bugatti Type 57SC Atlantic**: 518 pieces, 18 wood species, 95×85 cm.
- **Trophée du bureau du Roi Louis XV**: 1,050 pieces, 21 wood species, 69×61 cm. Reproduction of the original at the Château de Versailles using 18th-century wood species.
- **Prost VS Senna 1989** (chess set): 1,020 pieces, 51×51 cm, 300 hours.
- **Bugatti Vision Grand Sport & Type 41 Royale**: 700 pieces, 16 wood species, 111×86 cm, 300 hours.
- **Ferrari F12 Berlinetta Diptyque**: 2×80×80 cm, mirror-polished lacquer.
- **F1 Red Bull RB8 2012**: 544 pieces, 17 wood species, 97×43 cm, 250 hours.
- **Pur-sang Arabe**: 87×112 cm, fossil oak frame, wavy maple background.

## Commissions and Services

Three types of orders accepted:
1. **Catalogue purchase**: available finished works
2. **Bespoke creation**: custom subject, any format, from client brief
3. **Reproduction**: artworks, logos, heraldry reproduced in marquetry

All bespoke and reproduction work is priced on request via the contact form.
